project.purpose: Materialize the residual verified Workstation owner contracts without reproducing upstream systemd, Ansible, pgBackRest, CloudEvents, rclone, or Runtime semantics.

nodes.label: ExactSourceInputIngress
nodes.responsibility: Accept declared external input authority and source provenance, fetch bounded bytes through native carriers and commit only digest-matching materialization with durable idempotent receipt.
nodes.authority: Workstation node-local desired-state and materialization evidence; external provider/domain/Runtime truth remains external
inputs: versioned ingress request, exact source/provenance, expected SHA-256, target authority and relative object
configured source carriers and owner-authorized target root
outputs: immutable digest-qualified local target bytes and receipt, or typed conflict/refusal
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject unsupported/secret-looking provenance fields, unsafe target traversal, oversized/altered bytes and conflicted duplicate request identities; only a source-matching result can commit; Runtime remains the separate executor for later Jobs.
acceptance: Owner ingress tests cover exact source-bound acceptance, conflict/replay, unsafe paths and provider failures; this does not attest downstream Runtime consumption.
mustNotOwn: Runtime Job/Attempt execution identity and authority
second scheduler or generic orchestration engine
formalObligations: Refinement of actual OS file atomicity and Runtime input admission across every provider/storage/mount topology is UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: NodeLocalToolMaterialization
nodes.responsibility: Resolve caller-selected installed Linux/Windows tool/equipment to exact native binary path, digest, observed package version and target without selecting task/domain meaning.
nodes.authority: Workstation node-local desired-state and materialization evidence; external provider/domain/Runtime truth remains external
outputs: source-qualified executable identity and observed version, or typed unavailable/ambiguous failure
nodes.behavioralContract: Binding is stable only for exact observed bytes and node context; unavailable/ambiguous launcher cannot be declared available; Runtime or domain owns physical execution and suitability decisions.
acceptance: Native tool-binding/equipment tests assert wrong-platform, missing/multiple binaries, version UNKNOWN and selection failure behavior.
mustNotOwn: Runtime Job/Attempt execution identity and authority
second scheduler or generic orchestration engine
formalObligations: Version/source observation is not an installed/Executed Job guarantee and target path may change after read.

nodes.label: InteractiveShellPathProjection
nodes.responsibility: Compile one owner-local PATH desired-state expression for interactive login and non-login Bash sessions, excluding Runtime job PATH authority.
nodes.authority: Workstation node-local desired-state and materialization evidence; external provider/domain/Runtime truth remains external
inputs: Home Manager PATH expression and declared shim/Cargo directories
outputs: identical environment PATH projection for both interactive Bash modes
nodes.behavioralContract: A single source expression must feed both Home Manager environment and Bash startup; missing shims or divergence are rejected by an independent expected-value consumer test.
acceptance: Workstation consequence tests compare the actual projected source PATH in both shell modes and reject mismatched expressions.
mustNotOwn: Runtime Job/Attempt execution identity and authority
second scheduler or generic orchestration engine
formalObligations: Applying desired-state config does not imply a currently active new interactive session, WSL generation or Runtime execution environment.

nodes.label: CrossOwnerIntegrationEventProfile
nodes.responsibility: Specify CloudEvents 1.0 and AsyncAPI 3.0 schema envelopes for integration handoff between Workstation-owned n8n edge and external Distribution/Host/domain consumers.
nodes.authority: Workstation node-local desired-state and materialization evidence; external provider/domain/Runtime truth remains external
inputs: typed integration event payload and external correlation identity
CloudEvents and AsyncAPI schema with conditional provider readback claims
outputs: validated bounded event contract or structured rejection; no broker or provider effect
nodes.behavioralContract: Blocked provider effects cannot assert providerCalled or external effect performed; readback is a read-only GET observation, not a successful write; schemas do not instantiate a new event transport.
acceptance: Existing schema acceptance tests reject false externalEffectPerformed flags and retain externally-owned Distribution semantics.
mustNotOwn: Runtime Job/Attempt execution identity and authority
second scheduler or generic orchestration engine
formalObligations: This verifies local envelope shape only; actual n8n/Temporal/Runtime/consumer delivery and domain acceptance remain UNKNOWN.

knownGaps: Four contracts have distinguishable consumers but no claimed intra-Workstation dependency edge; cross-owner dynamic links require independent evidence.
Upstream providers (Ansible/systemd/pgBackRest/OPA/CloudEvents/etc.) are capabilities Workstation composes, not new Workstation-specific LEGO implementations.
Current installed Windows/WSL/Linux environment differs from source-desired state; source projection cannot upgrade to installed/executed currentness.
Zero discovered consumer is not certified absence; external provider behavior and historical retired paths are not restored.
